messages:
Marta B.: quick flag: our rollout pin model assumes one global TTL and it's clashing with tenant-specific release cadences. thinking we need tenant-scoped pins or a compact declared vs materialized model.
Joel R.: agree. what's the minimal schema change?
Marta B.: propose fields: `pin_scope` enum (global|tenant|cohort), optional `ttl_seconds`, `soft_expiry` bool, `revoke_reason` string. semantics: tenant overrides fall back to global.
Sam K.: how to handle staged canaries across many tenants? single pin with per-tenant overrides will get messy.
Anika P.: prefer multiple materialized pins (one per tenant/cohort) for clearer observability and eviction.
Dave (infra): multiple rows are easier for GC/quota but increase cardinality. we need index+gc plan for spikes (eg 10k tenants).
Marta B.: hybrid: keep a low-cardinality declared pin in rollout manifest; materialize per-tenant pins lazily on first-hit or explicit pin action. add `materialized_from` reference.
Joel R.: declared vs materialized split sounds good. add `created_by_rollout` and `last_probe_ts` on materialized pins to prune idle ones. GC: if last_probe_ts + ttl < now and declared pin removed -> evict.
Sam K.: also add `pin_version_hash` or `release_epoch` to detect drift when rollout updates model/version; reconciliation job can upgrade or evict based on policy.
Anika P.: telemetry: charts showing declared vs materialized counts per rollout, evictions, and a threshold alert when materialized_count grows unexpectedly.
Dave (infra): storage knobs: 1) declared pins stored compactly keyed by rollout_id; 2) materialized pins indexed by (tenant_id, model_id); 3) async materialize path in auth/proxy to avoid blocking initial requests.
Marta B.: draft example for docs: 
```
{
  "rollout_id": "r-202",
  "declared_pin": {
    "model_id": "redwood/fast-13b",
    "pin_scope": "global",
    "ttl_seconds": "86400",
    "soft_expiry": "true"
  },
  "materialized_pin": { optional when created 
    "tenant_id": "t-42",
    "materialized_from": "r-202",
    "created_ts": "1770004600",
    "last_probe_ts": "1770004700",
    "pin_version_hash": "sha256:abcd..."
  }
}
```
Joel R.: edgecases: materialized pin exists and rollout updates to different model -> reconciliation must detect mismatch by pin_version_hash and either migrate or evict. backfill: convert legacy global pins into declared pins and lazily materialize for tenants with recent traffic.
Sam K.: GC heuristics: reclaim materialized pins if idle > ttl and declared pin absent. add metrics for reclaimed_count to validate heuristics.
Anika P.: ops/UI: surface materialized_count on rollout page and provide a per-rollout list to inspect stray pins. also allow forced materialize for debugging.
Dave (infra): i'll prototype storage layout, index patterns, and GC job. Marta/Joel please write a short RFC with API examples and lifecycle rules; i'll attach perf estimates.
Marta B.: will draft RFC and ping.
ops-bot: schema-check: declared_pin additions appear backward compatible. run `make schema-check` on the RFC branch before merge. :white_check_mark:
